data.body: **[P2] Deserialize inspection results with the operation's effective SerDes.** This always uses the runner-wide SerDes. With global Jackson and `StepConfig.serDes(fileSystemSerDes)`, execution succeeds but `getStepResult()` passes the filesystem envelope to Jackson and fails. Preserve or resolve the effective SerDes per operation when constructing `TestOperation`—and expose an equivalent resolver for cloud history—then extend the operation-override integration test to inspect the step result.
